# Ayushman Tripathy - Portfolio

Full Stack Developer and Linux enthusiast from Kalahandi, Odisha, India. This site is a terminal-inspired portfolio showcasing projects, blogs, and personal logs.

## Core Information
- **Name:** Ayushman Tripathy
- **Role:** Full Stack Developer, CP Enthusiast, Linux Enthusiast
- **Location:** Kalahandi, Odisha, India
- **Birth Date:** 2004-08-08
- **Primary Tech Stack:** React, Svelte, Node.js, Linux, Python, Go

## Navigation
- [Home](https://ayushmantripathy.netlify.app/) - Personal bio (/etc/motd) and journey log (git log).
- [Blogs](https://ayushmantripathy.netlify.app/blogs) - Technical articles and personal insights in 'man page' format.
- [Links](https://ayushmantripathy.netlify.app/links) - Curated list of articles, books, and resources.
- [Movies](https://ayushmantripathy.netlify.app/movies) - A log of watched movies/TV shows in a psql-style table.

## About the Site
The site follows a strict dark-mode, gray-palette CLI aesthetic. It uses SvelteKit and is hosted on Netlify.
